shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 with altcoins showing gains and strong institutional ETF inflows continuing.
A critical week for markets with key CPI and PPI inflation data due, and Kevin Warsh officially taking over as the new Fed Chair.
Mixed signals on US-Iran tensions, with some reports of easing, while an upcoming Trump-Xi meeting adds trade and oil supply risks.
The US Senate is slated to vote on the CLARITY Act this week, potentially bringing more regulatory clarity for stablecoins.
Significant whale accumulation and a new $125 million DeFi fund launched; ETH is technically targeting $3,000.
